data.name: Jaami
data.gender_notes: Jaami is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Jaami refers to a gathering, assembly or reunion. In Islamic history, it is also the name of several scholars and Sufi saints known for their knowledge and wisdom. It is a unifying name that brings people together and signifies unity in faith. The name Jaami carries the meaning “Gathering, assembly” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Jaami usually hope their child will grow to embody gathering, assembly and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Bringing people together in faith and knowledge
data.etymology: Jaami belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gathering, assembly.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jaami total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_arabic.name: جامع
in_arabic.meaning: جامع يعني جامع كل شيء أو جامع الناس
in_arabic.long_meaning: الجامع هو من الأسماء التي تعبر عن شمولية الله تعالى في جمعه لجميع خلقه، وقد وردت هذه الكلمة في القرآن الكريم في عدة مواضع، منها قوله تعالى: 'والله جامع الناس' (آل عمران: 195)، وتعني هذه الكلمة في اللغة العربية جمع الشيء أو ضم الأشياء المختلفة، وتوحي بالشمول والاحتواء.

in_urdu.name: جامع
in_urdu.meaning: جامع مطلب ہے ہر چیز کو جمع کرنے والا
in_urdu.long_meaning: جامع نام کا مطلب ہے تمام چیزوں کو اکٹھا کرنے والا یا لوگوں کو جمع کرنے والا، یہ نام عربی زبان سے ماخوذ ہے جہاں اس کا مطلب ہے جمع کرنا یا ضم کرنا، اسلامی تقالید میں اس نام کا استعمال شائع ہے خاص طور پر جنوبی ایشیا میں جہاں اردو زبان بولی جاتی ہے، اور یہ نام اللہ تعالی کی صفت کے طور پر بھی استعمال ہوتا ہے جو تمام مخلوقات کو جمع کرنے والا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: जामे
in_hindi.meaning: जामे का अर्थ है सब कुछ इकट्ठा करने वाला
in_hindi.long_meaning: जामे नाम का अर्थ है सभी चीजों को इकट्ठा करने वाला या लोगों को एकत्रित करने वाला, यह नाम अरबी भाषा से लिया गया है जहां इसका अर्थ है इकट्ठा करना या एक साथ लाना, भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में इस नाम का उपयोग आम है और यह नाम अल्लाह की विशेषता के रूप में भी प्रयोग किया जाता है जो सभी सृष्टि को इकट्ठा करने वाला है, यह नाम पारंपरिक और आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है।

in_pashto.name: جامع
in_pashto.meaning: جامع یعنی د ټولو شیانو راټولونکی
in_pashto.long_meaning: جامع نوم معنی لري ټول شیان یا خلک راټولونکی، دا نوم د عربي ژبې څخه اخیستل شوی دی چیرته چې د راټولولو یا یوځای کولو معنی لري، په افغان او پښتني دودیزو کړنو کې دا نوم کارول شوی دی او دا نوم د الله تعالی د صفت په توګه هم کارول شوی دی چې ټول مخلوقات راټولونکی دی، دا نوم د پښتو کلتور او اسلامی دودیزو ارزښتونو سره تړاو لري.

in_english.name: Jaami
in_english.meaning: Jaami means one who gathers or collects everything
in_english.long_meaning: The name Jaami originates from Arabic roots and signifies one who gathers, collects, or brings together. It appears in the Quran, highlighting Allah's attribute of gathering all people. In Islamic tradition, Jaami symbolizes inclusivity and unity. The name carries spiritual significance, implying a comprehensive and unifying presence. Across various Muslim cultures, Jaami is used to denote a unifying force or a collector of diverse elements.

pronunciation.urdu: جامع کا تلفظ ہے جاہ می
pronunciation.hindi: जामे का उच्चारण है जाह मे
pronunciation.pashto: د جامع تلفظ دی جاه می

It symbolizes the coming together of like-minded individuals to seek knowledge, wisdom and spiritual growth. The Jaami Masjid, or Confluence Mosque, is an example of this concept, where people from different walks of life gather to worship and learn.

The gatherings and assemblies associated with the name Jaami serve as a reminder of the importance of community and the sharing of knowledge and wisdom among believers. The name Jaami can be seen as a call to unite in faith and seek the guidance and wisdom of Allah and each other.

historical_references.reference: The term 'Jaami' is derived from the Arabic word 'jamaa' which means 'gathering' or 'assembly'. It was widely used during the medieval Islamic period to refer to institutions of learning and research, primarily in the Islamic world. During this time, madrasas or educational institutions were established to promote Islamic studies and teach various sciences and liberal arts to students.

The famous Islamic scholar and philosopher Al-Jahiz (776-869 CE) is also known as Abu Ubaidah Jarir ibn Abdallah Al-Jahiz. He was an influential writer, naturalist, and anthropologist during the Abbasid Caliphate. Al-Jahiz is considered one of the pioneers of Arabic literature and his works include various genres such as biography, history, and natural sciences. The term 'Jaami' was used in the title of some of his works, which were compilations of various knowledge sources on different topics.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name 'Jaami' has become synonymous with Islamic education, community building, and digital transformation. The Jaami App is a popular mobile application that offers a comprehensive suite of educational resources for students and teachers. Jaami.net is an online platform that connects Muslims worldwide, fostering a sense of global community through its various features like discussion forums and live events. JaamiHub, a physical community space, serves as a hub for local Islamic organizations and events, bridging the gap between the online and offline worlds.
